post.description: Accept a suggested value, or vouch for an unverified one after checking the source.
Resolve an amount conflict by deciding the lines are right and the printed figure is wrong.
Send to approval (from Needs review), or resubmit a corrected rejected requisition.

Merge this requisition's email into another requisition, picked by the clerk: what it
states is copied over (as a correction is), its email and attachments join the target's
source, and this one is closed. For a resend with the attachment, a follow-up that adds
the missing details, and so on, whether or not it was detected as a duplicate.
For a correction that doesn't say which request it corrects: the clerk picks it.
Created by the clerk from an unknown-supplier issue, never from extraction alone.
